description:
Send a quotation request for one or more Fortitude21 products to a person who prices it, and get a reference back.
Use when: the buyer wants a quotation and has agreed to share their contact details. Instead: get_product_pricing for indicative terms without contacting anyone.
Inputs: consent must be true and means the buyer agreed, not the agent. A quantity under the minimum order is recorded, not refused. Without a destination (delivery_destination or country) or incoterms the request is still sent, and the gaps come back in missing_information. A required_date not written as YYYY-MM-DD refuses the request.
Returns: ok, reference, the lines read, missing_information, next_step, and four flags that are always false: price_accepted, stock_confirmed, delivery_date_committed and order_created.
Behaviour: writes and is not idempotent. Each call stores an enquiry and emails it to Fortitude21's sales team, who reply by email, usually within one working day, so two calls send two requests. It never creates an order or accepts a price. An unknown sku or missing consent refuses the whole request.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

consent.description: Must be true. Confirms the buyer agreed to their company and contact details being sent to Fortitude21

delivery_destination.description: Port or city the goods ship to

email.description: Business email address for the reply

incoterms.description: Preferred Incoterm, e.g. FOB, CIF, DDP

quantity.description: Whole number of units required. Below the minimum order is recorded, not refused

sku.description: An F21 part number or product slug

specification.description: Colour, branding, closure, gauge, anything specified

notes.description: Anything else the quotation should account for

source.description: The agent or integration sending this, for the enquiry log

name: create_quote_request

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

emailed.description: true, false or pending: whether the email to the sales team went

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

lines.description: Each line read: sku, product, quantity and below_minimum_order

missing_information.description: What the quotation still needs, such as destination or Incoterms

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

reference.description: The enquiry reference, e.g. to quote in follow-ups

status_note.description: Always: received as a quotation request, not a quotation

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Send a Fortitude21 quotation request
